metadata.title: Circular padding in Conv2d applies padding across the wrong dimension (regression from 1.4)

bug_description:
## 🐛 Bug



If you specify different padding for the H and W dimensions, `padding_mode='circular'` applies it across the wrong one - e.g, with padding `(0, 1)`, it will pad across the *H* dimension, even though it should apply it on the *W* one.

trigger_conditions.condition: Using Conv2d with spatial tuple parameters where height and width values differ (e.g., asymmetric padding), causing incorrect dimension mapping or output behavior.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: Using nn.Conv2d with padding_mode='circular' and asymmetric padding tuple (h, w) where h != w, so padding is applied to the wrong spatial dimension.

failure_behavior.description: Using nn.Conv2d with padding_mode='circular' and asymmetric padding tuple (h, w) where h != w, so padding is applied to the wrong spatial dimension.
